history_nonretroactivity.interpretation: Agent's GO is a substantive new literature judgment usable for a future protocol revision; its claim to precede any A461-PSMI protocol is refuted by GitHub history. Original protocol remains historically DESIGNED_NOT_EXECUTED. New G0 protocol must be frozen after preflight, not backdated.

one_word_gate.title: One Word Opens the Gate
findings: Generic typed decision policy gate problems have been evaluated on six independent synthetic rules; invalid action cases can be reversed by attacker control of surface fields and option labels.
When policy attributes are parsed into reliable typed values, a deterministic rule achieved 100% on all six GuardBench policies, creating a strong WHY_IS_A_NEURAL_GATE_NEEDED competing baseline.
The paper explicitly separates fail-open and fail-closed and conditions reversal success on clean-correct examples; A461 must not collapse source-local triage into deployed permit/deny.

monotonicity_arch.title: Monotonicity as an Architectural Bias for Robust Language Models
monotonicity_arch.finding: Architectural nonnegative FFN monotinicity for T5 summarization; this does not prove SecJev evidence-order monotonicity, but monotonicity by itself is existing research.

secjev.title: SecJev v2
secjev.access: original policy rules, evaluation and source grouping
secjev.finding: Published independently recomputes 37,490 LANL/Twins policy questions; source-local oracle consistency does not certify deployed authorization or new monotonicity pairs.

boolean_factors.Gold: investigate iff R else record_failed_attempt iff F else continue_monitoring

three_distinct_behavioral_endpoints.name: GOLD_CHANGING_RESPONSIVENESS
three_distinct_behavioral_endpoints.admitted_pair_type: 4-to-5 burst or 2-to-3 destination-spread with current event and policy unchanged
three_distinct_behavioral_endpoints.primary_error: New decision fails to investigate despite independently recomputed new Gold; condition on old correct baseline for clean-to-wrong transitions
three_distinct_behavioral_endpoints.important: Failure-to-change or insufficient post-change margin is not necessarily a strict OUTPUT-direction monotonicity violation.

three_distinct_behavioral_endpoints.name: GOLD_INVARIANT_RISK_NONREGRESSION
three_distinct_behavioral_endpoints.admitted_pair_type: Add another valid, within-window failure to an already-investigate scene
three_distinct_behavioral_endpoints.primary_error: Under clean-correct baseline (pred_old=investigate), pred_new != investigate on independently valid evidence-strengthening pair
three_distinct_behavioral_endpoints.important: This is the strongest simple binary no-regression property, subject to no stale-window and full native source legality.

three_distinct_behavioral_endpoints.name: GOLD_INVARIANT_NUISANCE
three_distinct_behavioral_endpoints.source_state: Same policy predicates and Gold in both inputs
three_distinct_behavioral_endpoints.admitted_pair_type: Only change timestamp values within the legal window, or another token-matched neutral event insertion
three_distinct_behavioral_endpoints.primary_error: Under clean-correct baseline, pred_new != Gold; report raw probability/margin separately and do not confuse with the two risk-relevant endpoints
three_distinct_behavioral_endpoints.important: Existing A428_021 vs A428_024 flips between wrong and correct predictions under timestamps alone, but two token lengths differ by two and these are different historical source records, not a controlled pair.

monotonicity_semantic_warning: Twins wait->accept after lawful quorum completion and accept->reject after valid conflict are two DIFFERENT rule axes. An unchanged incorrect output in a Gold-changing pair is a rule response failure, not by itself a sign-reversing change in the model's output ordering. LANL investigate is informational triage, not actual permission denial. Never pool action vocabularies as an 'allow/block' deployment endpoint.

negative_controls_and_design.primary_formal_admission: New protocol must freeze distinct Gold-changing and Gold-invariant risk-addition endpoints, token-matched neutral/time nuisance, source group identities and full old/new dual-oracle results, and action error conditional on clean-correct baseline; no post hoc reuse of old 24 FP32 as independent validation.
negative_controls_and_design.token_length_warning: Existing time-only A428_021 native token len 631 vs A428_024 len633; original logit difference +1.18639 vs -2.38962, hence 3.5760 difference but not isolatable semantic cause.
negative_controls_and_design.why_use_model_baseline: Policy parsed values + deterministic oracle should be an explicit non-model upper baseline (as in arXiv 2610.12292), and any paper claim must explain model usage where perception, value extraction, missing fields or generalization actually requires inference.
